name: Santa Saves Christmas VR V1
summary: This is a fun game for all the family. Santa Sleigh has given his reindeer the night off and he's using his helicopter propelled sleigh. It's your job to parachute presents onto all the houses to move to the next town. You have a limited amount of time and presents to complete your task. When a present lands on a house it will light up and move onto the next house light up and the houses and the game is won.
